shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- PACKAGE ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- APP FILES ---\\n'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -120"
